detail: Science Corp. raised $400 million in a Series D funding round.
why_relevant: Science Corp. is a leading neural engineering company developing visual prosthetics and brain-computer interfaces, making it highly relevant for biosignal processing and neuromodulation.

detail: Neuralink demonstrated a patient controlling gameplay in GTA VI directly through thoughts using their brain-computer interface implant.
why_relevant: Neuralink is a pioneer in high-channel invasive brain-computer interfaces, directly aligning with real-time neural decoding and neuromodulation research.

detail: Multiwave secured FDA clearance for MGNTQv0, an ultra-low-field AI-powered portable brain MRI device, enabling its commercial launch and US assembly expansion in Lowell, Massachusetts.
why_relevant: Multiwave integrates neuroimaging hardware with AI signal processing, directly relevant to biomedical imaging and neurotech algorithm development.

detail: Nurosym announced the expansion of its wearable vagus nerve stimulation device to address sleep health in the UK market.
why_relevant: Nurosym develops wearable neuromodulation technology using noninvasive electrostimulation, perfectly aligned with biosignal-driven neural modulation.

detail: Researchers at Rutgers University developed ChatBCI-Assist, an LLM-guided noninvasive scalp-EEG brain-computer interface reaching up to 30.7 characters per minute.
why_relevant: This project combines EEG signal decoding with real-time machine learning and language models for noninvasive BCI communication.

detail: earKART obtained FDA listings across four hearing-aid device categories.
why_relevant: earKART operates in the wearable auditory medtech space, relevant to biosignal processing and medical wearable device deployment.

detail: Suki raised $90 million in Series E funding to expand its AI platform and ambient clinical workflow automation.
why_relevant: Suki develops AI systems for clinical applications, providing strong context for healthtech machine learning and natural language processing.

detail: 2EyesVision raised €473,000 in co-investment funding to advance its ophthalmic medical technologies.
why_relevant: 2EyesVision focuses on optical medical devices, offering insights into medtech hardware and physiological optical sensing.

detail: Inovalon acquired DrFirst to expand its healthtech software and digital health footprint.

detail: Alignd raised funding to expand its healthcare management and care technology offerings.
